english_description: An experimental subject caught between intoxication and sobriety. Drugs grant powerful effects but continuously build Poison. When all Poison is cleared, he enters Sober, gaining faster attacks, a higher critical chance, and steadily regenerating Shield.
chinese_description: 一名在藥效與清醒之間反覆拉扯的實驗體。藥物能帶來強力效果，卻會讓中毒持續累積；當中毒完全代謝，他將進入清醒狀態，獲得更快的攻擊、更高的爆擊率與持續恢復的護盾。

english_description: A high-stakes gunslinger who turns bad odds into deadly momentum. Lower accuracy raises his critical chance; every miss improves the odds of the next hit becoming critical, while each critical hit feeds a Hot Streak that lasts for the rest of the battle.
chinese_description: 一名把劣勢賠率化為致命攻勢的亡命賭徒。命中率越低，爆擊率越高；每次未命中都會提高下一次命中攻擊的爆擊機率，而每次爆擊又會讓手氣持續升溫，直到戰鬥結束。
